title: Oahu's Top Hawaiian Food & Scenic Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: This is a meat eating tour. Pork will be on the menu.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour is all inclusive! Meaning all food is included!

Visiting Hawaiʻi is often a once-in-a-lifetime trip — and this tour is built to make the most of it. We’ve carefully curated the must-try local and Hawaiian foods that define the island’s flavors, from malasadas to garlic shrimp and traditional dishes.

But this isn’t just a food tour. Between tastings, you’ll visit some of Oʻahu’s most scenic and iconic locations — stunning coastlines, mountain lookouts, and quiet beach spots that make the island unforgettable.

It’s the best of both worlds: delicious, authentic food and incredible photo-worthy views. Perfect for first-timers who want to experience a true taste of Hawaiʻi — in every sense.
